_about: Pre-scripted FreshFind Assistant (SRS 1.5: static, rule-based chatbot loaded from JSON; no AI or backend). Edit the answers here; the logic lives in src/services/chatbotService.js. {placeholders} are filled from the market and produce data.
greeting: Hi! 👋 I can help you find markets, opening hours and what’s in season. What are you looking for?

search.none: I couldn’t find any markets{filters}. Try another day, area or produce.

produce.answer: {name} is {season}. You can find it at {count} {markets}{closest}.

intents.answer: Hello! Ask me about markets, opening days, areas or produce.
You’re welcome! Enjoy your market trip. 🧺
Here are the markets closest to you:
intents.denied: I need your location to find markets near you. You can allow location access in your browser, or tell me an area, like “markets in Yaba”.

intents.answer: Most markets take cash and bank transfer. Some also accept card.
Several markets have dedicated parking. Street parking fills up early on weekends, so arrive before 9 AM.
Some markets sell at wholesale prices, which is good for bulk buying.
We’d love to list your market! Send us the name, address, days and hours.
Tap the bookmark on any market or produce card to save it. On the Saved page you can add notes, download your list or share it.
You can reach the FreshFind team on hello@freshfind.ng or through the contact form.
Tell me a market, an area or a day and I’ll show the hours, for example “Sunday markets in Lekki” or “markets open now”.

fallback.answer: Sorry, I didn’t catch that. You can ask about an area (“markets in Yaba”), a day (“Sunday markets”), produce (“where can I get mangoes”) or “markets near me”.
